description.en-US: OpenBiliClaw is a local-first, open-source AI content discovery companion. Its Firefox sidebar connects to the OpenBiliClaw backend you run, collects only the supported browsing and interaction signals described in the privacy policy, and turns them into cross-source recommendations, an inspectable private profile, and feedback-driven tuning. Supported sources include Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, X, Zhihu, Reddit, Linux.do, Bangumi, V2EX, and Weibo. Weibo is backend-only discovery: the extension requests no Weibo host permission, reads no Weibo cookie, and runs no Weibo page task. The extension does not send data to servers operated by the OpenBiliClaw developers.
description.zh-CN: OpenBiliClaw 是本地优先、开源的 AI 内容发现伙伴。Firefox 侧边栏连接由你自行运行的 OpenBiliClaw 后端，仅采集隐私政策中说明的受支持浏览与互动信号，并生成跨来源推荐、可查看的私有画像和可持续反馈调教的推荐结果。支持 B站、小红书、抖音、YouTube、X、知乎、Reddit、Linux.do、Bangumi、V2EX 与微博。微博仅由本地后端做公开 discovery：插件不申请微博 host permission、不读取微博 Cookie，也不执行微博页面任务。插件不会把数据发送到 OpenBiliClaw 开发者运营的服务器。

version.approval_notes: OpenBiliClaw is local-first and requires a user-run backend. It does not load remote code or send telemetry to servers operated by the project. The optional all-sites host permission is requested only when a user explicitly configures a non-local backend; public hosts require HTTPS and device authentication. The declared data categories cover supported-site browsing/activity signals, user-triggered search and source tasks, locally stored authentication status, and comments/chat/danmaku text only after the user successfully submits it. Linux.do (`https://linux.do/*`) and V2EX (`https://*.v2ex.com/*`) permissions are read-only. Linux.do tasks use same-origin GETs for public topics or, after `/session/current.json` confirms identity, the current user's bookmarks/likes/read history; only normalized fields and a boolean login heartbeat leave the site tab. V2EX tasks return bounded rendered fields for the user's topics, public replies, favorite topics, and favorite Nodes; only A2 existence becomes a login boolean. Cookie values, page HTML, CSRF/once, private messages, and browser history are never uploaded, and the extension performs no V2EX write actions or Linux.do posting, liking, bookmarking, following, editing, or other site mutation. Weibo discovery is backend-only and adds no Weibo extension permission. Data is sent only to the backend endpoint configured by the user. A reproducible source archive is attached; from its root run `cd extension`, `npm ci`, then `npm run build:firefox` using Node.js 22. The output submitted for review is `extension/dist-firefox`. See docs/firefox-amo-source-build.md and docs/privacy.md for the complete build and data-flow explanation.

release_notes.en-US: Adds Linux.do as an opt-in read-only source, hardens V2EX account isolation and task recovery, and adds backend-only anonymous Weibo discovery. Public discovery, signed-in personal-signal imports, text cards, and partial-result handling are included without adding any site write action.
release_notes.zh-CN: 新增默认关闭、严格只读的 Linux.do 来源，强化 V2EX 账号隔离与任务恢复，并加入仅后端匿名读取的微博 discovery；支持公开发现、登录态个人信号、文字卡与部分结果保留，不增加任何站内写操作。
